description: NaBO₂ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.59 Å. B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.31 Å) and two longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to five equivalent Na and one B atom.
